seeds.title: Establish the GitHub software-factory foundation
seeds.intent: Preserve product intent and decisions and manage bounded work in GitHub.
acceptance: Document product scope and architecture choices.
Provide issue intake, worker and reviewer handoffs, and a finite seed backlog.
Prove a second publication creates no duplicate issues and preserves current issue content.
Record current-head checks and independent review in a pull request. Keep workers, schedules, releases and automatic merging disabled.
verification: Run plan and seed twice against a test repository; compare issue IDs and bodies.

seeds.title: Demonstrate bounded h2a access from OpenShell
seeds.intent: Show a sandbox using h2a as its provider and receiving explicit policy denials. Earlier OpenShell proof covered one successful request before bounded keys were added.
acceptance: Use an isolated temporary gateway and exact-model-scoped expiring key.
From a real OpenShell sandbox, show one completion followed by quota denial and revocation denial without printing the key.
Record exact tool versions, cleanup and network route. Label fixture results separately.
Preserve unrelated Docker resources. If prerequisites fail, record the failure and continue independent work.
verification: Run the documented OpenShell profile lint and sandbox request flow.
Record HTTP status and sanitized response shape for success, quota denial and revocation.
Check task-owned processes and sandbox/provider resources are removed.

seeds.title: Verify native release and Windows policy behavior
seeds.intent: Convert cross-compilation evidence into native execution evidence before making platform support claims.
acceptance: Link hosted Linux, macOS and Windows test outcomes to their tested commit.
Exercise a built archive on supported native runners with help and an offline key lifecycle.
Distinguish direct-child cancellation from descendant cleanup. Reproduce any unsupported behavior before proposing a process-management fix.
Update verification records without treating all architecture targets as natively tested.
verification: cargo test --all-targets on each native runner.
Download or build the matching archive, check its checksum, and run the smoke commands.
Record runner architecture, command output and any skipped checks.

seeds.title: Resolve the remaining live provider verification gaps
seeds.intent: Keep adapter claims tied to observed account access. Gemini, Claude, OpenCode and IBM Bob currently have protocol evidence but no successful live-account inference in this checkout.
acceptance: Split execution into one provider at a time after an authorized login, required project configuration and a bounded request allowance are available.
Use the ordinary authenticated h2a probe path with a one-request key and a short deadline.
Record the outcome without credentials, raw provider diagnostics or claims that request caps bound dollar spend.
Do not replace a failed live request with a fixture and call it verified.
verification: Inspect available official CLI login status without reading credential contents.
Run one explicitly authorized h2a probe and inspect its accepted-request count.

seeds.title: Validate the documented Docker runtime recipe
seeds.intent: Verify the container recipe on an isolated Docker host.
acceptance: On a healthy isolated host, build the documented image and run its offline health/key lifecycle.
Record image contents, supported adapters and credential mount requirements.
Keep provider inference opt-in. Do not reset or delete unrelated Docker state to make the check pass.
verification: Run the documented image build and an isolated offline smoke check; record exact commands.

seeds.title: Run one bounded issue through the factory handoff
seeds.intent: Evaluate the source-to-issue-to-PR workflow before adding a scheduler or autonomous launcher.
acceptance: Select one ready issue with accepted dependencies and give one worker an isolated worktree.
Record issue, base SHA, branch, owned paths, time/request limits and verification contract before dispatch.
Obtain an independent review of the exact returned head and record the human merge outcome.
Report manual steps and observed friction. Do not implement a scheduler as part of the pilot.
verification: Compare the issue handoff, returned commit, CI results and review findings.
Confirm there are no duplicate active workers or issue claims.

seeds.title: Prepare the release installation channel
seeds.intent: Distribute harness-to-api as the h2a executable with verifiable native archives.
acceptance: Use harness-to-api as the project name and h2a as the executable.
Provide versioned native archives and checksums.
Track package-manager setup and artifact verification in GitHub issues.
verification: Build release archives and verify their checksums.
Check documented installation commands on supported native platforms.
